summary.text: Joey Hensley is a Republican state senator from Hohenwald representing Tennessee Senate District 28 (Giles, Lewis, Marshall, Maury and part of Williamson Counties). A physician, he served in the House for the 103rd through 107th General Assemblies and the Senate since the 108th.

paragraphs.text: Hensley was born on July 28, 1955, in Hohenwald and holds an A.S. from Columbia State Community College, a B.S. from the University of Memphis and an M.D. from the University of Tennessee-Memphis.
He is a fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians.
He is a former chairman of the Lewis County School Board, a former member of the Lewis County Commission and the Lewis County medical examiner.
In the Senate he is second vice-chair of the Finance, Ways, and Means Committee and also serves on the Education and Health and Welfare committees.
